summary.text: Hoang Nguyen is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 23 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Hoang Nguyen succeeded Brian King as the representative for District 23.
According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes working as a small business owner, serving as managing partner of Sapa Investments and as chief executive officer of Dragonfly Wellness.
